construction: The inherited X/Y sigil projection is divided by one selected FP axis. Each half-plane rotates rigidly from 0 to 90 degrees toward positive Z.
invariants: distance between points that occupy the same half-plane
changes: distance between points on opposite sides of the hinge
projected extent perpendicular to the hinge
limits: This is a reversible geometric study, not a material simulation. It folds one axis at a time and does not claim that the SS protocol itself folds.
